quick: Deficiency: 5 to 30 mg daily; migraine: 400 mg daily
summary: Riboflavin (vitamin B2) is a coenzyme precursor (FMN, FAD). Deficiency causes angular stomatitis, cheilosis and glossitis. High-dose riboflavin (400 mg/day) has evidence for migraine prophylaxis.

moa: Precursor of FMN and FAD in oxidation-reduction reactions.

counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
